                                       Not Recommended for New Designs
                                                                                                           ECS-100X Series
                                                                                                           Clock Oscillator
    The ECS-100X clock oscillator is fully compatible with TTL                                                                     Request a Sample
    circuitry. The metal package with pin #7 case ground acts as
    shielding to minimize radiation.

                                                    Part Numbering Guide:  Example ECS-100AX-100

                                      ECS      -          Series            -         Stability         -    Frequency Abbreviations

                                       ECS               100                              AX = ±100 PPM                            100 = 10.000 MHz
                                                         +5V TTL                          BX = ±50 PPM
